chapters.title: Twitter Space Troubleshooting
chapters.description: The episode opens with technical difficulties as the hosts explain the Twitter Space glitches that delayed the start. Scott eventually gets things working, and speakers Ishan and Anthony welcome the returning audience before introducing the JavaScript Jam Live format.

chapters.title: React Miami Month Announcement
chapters.description: Scott introduces himself and announces the collaboration between JavaScript Jam and React Miami, jokingly renaming it React Miami Month. He previews upcoming speakers from the conference and emphasizes the show's welcoming atmosphere for beginners and advanced developers alike.

chapters.title: Introducing Dev and Michelle
chapters.description: Dev Agrawal introduces himself as a media partner for React Miami alongside Anthony and Scott. Michelle, one of the React Miami organizers, joins despite connection issues, expressing enthusiasm for the media partnership and the freedom given to the team.

chapters.title: Miami Jam Game Show Concept
chapters.description: Dev explains Miami Jam, a game show format breaking from traditional interviews. React Miami speakers will answer trivia-style questions about React, JavaScript, and TypeScript quirks, creating an interactive experience that segues into deeper discussions about their talks.

chapters.title: Interactive Format and Audience Engagement
chapters.description: Dev continues describing the show's collaborative structure, noting that speakers will share experiences while the audience participates actively. Listeners can ask questions and even score the speakers' answers, making the event more engaging than a standard panel or interview format.
